Active Branches:
子, 丑 months
(Rat & Ox years)
Lifelong Traits: Father-type authority energy. Draws support from seniors & mentors. Excels at founding/institutionalizing. Strong sense of lineage and tradition. Natural authority figure.
Active Period Guidance: Avoid new businesses in 子/丑 years. Consolidate existing structures. Good time for inner reflection, mentoring, and cementing legacy.

Active Branches:
寅, 卯 months
(Tiger & Rabbit years)
Lifelong Traits: MOST DYNAMIC of all 6 types. Enormous energy reserve. Natural successor/inheritor. Sincere good intentions. Naturally gravitates to center of groups. Supported by peers & maternal figures. Seesaw between family and career.
Active Period Guidance: Resist launching new projects in 寅/卯 years. Strong energy becomes misdirected. Focus on receiving, consolidating, deepening relationships. Powerful time for spiritual development.

Active Branches:
辰, 巳 months
(Dragon & Snake years)
Karmic Theme:
The Individualist
'Do what no one else does'
Lifelong Traits: Fiercely original and non-conformist by nature. High aesthetic sense and creative vision. Thrives when doing something radically different from others. Deep spiritual and philosophical orientation.
Active Period Guidance: Avoid forcing conventional milestones (marriage, promotion) in 辰/巳 years. Spiritual practice, creative work, and philosophical exploration are strongly supported.

Active Branches:
午, 未 months
(Horse & Goat years)
Lifelong Traits: Bright, sociable, and naturally free-spirited. Excellent at ending things that need to end. Good with children and subordinates. Creative freedom and independence are core drives.
Active Period Guidance: Expect endings and completions in 午/未 years. Release what needs releasing. Resist clinging to what is blocking growth. Actually auspicious for completions and fresh starts.

Active Branches:
申, 酉 months
(Monkey & Rooster years)
Karmic Theme:
The Trusted Heir
'Receive and be trusted'
Lifelong Traits: Highly trustworthy and reliable — others naturally place confidence in them. Strong analytical intelligence. Excellent at inheriting and faithfully continuing established works. Knowledge accumulates steadily.
Active Period Guidance: Avoid major new intellectual or academic commitments in 申/酉 years. Trust accumulated wisdom rather than seeking new information. Focus on transmitting what you already know.

Active Branches:
戌, 亥 months
(Dog & Boar years)
Lifelong Traits: Deepest spiritual potential of all 6 types. Thoughtful, introspective, philosophically rich. Naturally attuned to the invisible and numinous. Creates meaning and sacred frameworks for others.
Active Period Guidance: External activity tends to be blocked in 戌/亥 years. Ideal time for retreat, meditation, spiritual study. Avoid forcing worldly achievements — the universe is asking for inner work.
